question.text: Two van der waal's gases have same value of <math> <mtext>a</mtext> </math> but different value of <math> <mtext>b</mtext> </math> which of the following statement is correct?

options.text: The smaller the value of b larger will be compressibility
The larger the value of b, larger will be compressibility
All the with smaller value of b will occupy larger volume

solution.text: Smaller the value of 'b', smaller the volume occupied by molecules so high      compressibility.
